notes:
New in 1.3.0:
• Image previews in network folders: photos and pictures on SMB shares, cloud accounts and other remotes now show thumbnails. Camera photos load from the small preview stored in the file. Turn it off in Settings › Photos, video & music.
• More reliable SMB and network folders: when a NAS or Wi-Fi drops the connection, BFE reconnects and tries again instead of failing over and over, and says plainly that the connection was lost.
• Error logs: when a network folder, transfer, archive, extraction or compression fails, BFE saves a dated report in Download/BFE that you can attach to a bug report. File names, accounts, addresses and passwords are left out. Settings › Troubleshooting.
• Thanks to Kanuahs for testing BFE against a NAS and reporting the SMB problems.
